node.title: L1 split-pencil content is exact-shell excess
node.statement: For any basis g1,g2 of the received-word interpolation module, let (W,N)=A g1+B g2 have W a monic squarefree complement locator of degree n-m and N=Wc with deg c<k. The monic coefficient content G=gcd(A,B) is basis invariant, divides W, and satisfies Agr_H(U,c)=(H\Z(W)) disjoint union Z(G), so agr(U,c)=m+deg G. Thus level-m exactness is equivalent to gcd(A,B)=1, while division by G uniquely sends every nonprimitive raw member to the same codeword at its true higher shell. The exact BC residual is precisely the primitive coprime coefficient-pair split-pencil census; no bound on that census is asserted.
